up: Return the exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL3436044. Provide the ChEMBL identifier for each compound, the standard activity type (e.g., IC50), the exact activity value with units, and the standard relation (e.g., '='). Include the activity ID.
sql:
SELECT
  a.activity_id,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3436044'
